name: sourcepoint-top
comment: Top-frame companion to Sourcepoint-frame. The message UI lives in a cross-origin iframe, so the top frame cannot tell a normal notice from a 'consent or pay' wall that Sourcepoint-frame has to bail on. This rule hides the message container and undoes the scroll lock regardless, using visibility rather than display so the iframe keeps its layout and Sourcepoint-frame can still complete a real rejection underneath.
